body.title: Introduce 'possibleSmartCasts' in 'KaScopeContext'
body.body: The new endpoint makes it possible to track potential smart casts in a particular position, even if a real cast isn't yet present in the source code.

In the [specification](https://kotlinlang.org/spec/type-inference.html#smart-cast-sink-stability) "smart cast source" has a different meaning. In the spec terms, this is a smart cast sink. To avoid using the word "sink", maybe we should call it `KaSmartCastPosition`?
Maybe `originalType` like we already have in `KaSmartCastInfo`? It could be clearer in use-site code.
I think something is wrong with the grammar here. It's better to proofread the docs before merging.

Analysis from Codex:

Found three issues:

1. **[P1] New API is added to the frozen legacy surface** — [KaScopeProvider.kt:317](/Users/alexey.belkov/code/kotlin/analysis/analysis-api/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/analysis/api/components/KaScopeProvider.kt:317)

   `possibleSmartCasts` and its public types are under `components/`, which is frozen during the endpoint-architecture migration. `AnalysisApiLegacySurfaceDumpTest` and `AnalysisApiLegacyCallableDumpTest` both fail. This should be exposed from a domain package as a context-session endpoint rather than updating the legacy dumps.

2. **[P1] New public interfaces are unintentionally extensible** — [KaScopeProvider.kt:328](/Users/alexey.belkov/code/kotlin/analysis/analysis-api/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/analysis/api/components/KaScopeProvider.kt:328), [KaScopeProvider.kt:373](/Users/alexey.belkov/code/kotlin/analysis/analysis-api/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/analysis/api/components/KaScopeProvider.kt:373)

   `KaSmartCastPossibility` and `KaSmartCastSource` lack `@SubclassOptInRequired(KaImplementationDetail::class)` or `@KaSpi`. `AnalysisApiExtensibilityTest` consequently fails, and the current API accidentally promises client implementability.

3. **[P2] Dispatch-receiver smart casts are silently discarded** — [KaFirScopeProvider.kt:380](/Users/alexey.belkov/code/kotlin/analysis/analysis-api-fir/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/analysis/api/fir/components/KaFirScopeProvider.kt:380)

   FIR represents a member function’s `this` as a `FirRegularClassSymbol`, which becomes a class symbol rather than `KaVariableSymbol`. The `takeIf` therefore drops valid cases such as `if (this is Bar)`. Widen the source representation to `KaDeclarationSymbol` or explicitly model `this`, and add the existing LL `dispatchReceiver.kt` scenario to the Analysis API tests.
The word "position" clashes with the literal position in code (text offsets), whereas an interface represents a node in the smart cast chain.

1. Addressed in https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/pull/7832/changes/c5db5ba3b2aa7f2b01a03c6362925cb5653bd490.
2. Addressed in https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/pull/7832/changes/c4df335902a8ae99c4d8a9f4d00dbc3608c2e488.
3. Addressed in https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/pull/7832/changes/ee0c772f8f696f40dbbabab89494b0203d36ee91, https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/pull/7832/changes/b846e9381784e7a247e75234175fd2b853b1ab1b and https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/pull/7832/changes/6d6a73f7e4ab25226820cb8366695639e35a1e4f.
